designNotes: Stop + Escalation: notification and the waiting list; the dashboard percentages await a formula

cases.title: "Stop + Escalation" notifies the manager and Master and waits until handled

steps.action: Choose Action "Stop + Escalation" on a logged set
steps.expected: The item is in the waiting list

steps.action: Open the manager's and Master's notifications
steps.expected: Each has a notice naming the customer and the set

steps.action: Reload the waiting list before anyone handles it
Handle the item as the manager
steps.expected: The item leaves the waiting list
